templates.title: Rehearsal: The Difficult Client
templates.description: Practice a difficult client conversation with an AI-played character who arrives in a different disposition every session.
templates.whatItShows: How to let the player talk freely with an AI-played character, and how one character can turn up in a different mood each time (cooperative, hostile, avoidant, undecided). Play it twice and compare.

templates.title: The Last Ferry — choose your character
templates.description: A night crossing in a storm. Pick who you are, back one of the crew in an argument, and see who stands by you when the ferry lurches.
templates.whatItShows: How to let the player choose who they are. Each scene is written once and works for whoever plays the part: the names and pronouns in the text follow the cast, and each character keeps their own trust meter. Play it twice as different people.

templates.title: Counters that read affect
templates.description: A character whose meters mirror trust, fear and mood, plus choices whose effects move them. Replace the text; keep the wiring.
templates.whatItShows: How to show what a character feels as meters on screen. Three meters follow trust, fear and mood by themselves; one is an ordinary counter. The choices change how the character feels, and the meters show it.

templates.title: The Oil Lamp — a museum story
templates.description: One object, three ways of seeing it: as a made thing, a used thing, and a taken thing. Swap in your own object; keep the structure.
templates.whatItShows: A text-only story with no pictures or sound to prepare: a hub of paths that dim once you have taken them, and words in the text you can click. It uses the light Clean Editorial look.

templates.title: 23:47 — a chat thriller
templates.description: A night train, a stranger’s phone on the seat opposite, and a thread you cannot put down. Keep Jo steady; choose her stop.
templates.whatItShows: A story told as phone messages: written chat bubbles, with a free conversation with an AI-played character in the middle, then back to the ending you choose. The character's notes (traits, mood, how she texts) keep the AI in her voice.

templates.title: Ordinary Wonders — a GPS walk
templates.description: A pocket expedition played outdoors: three wonders scattered within 150 m of wherever you stand. Walk to one, find what nobody else has noticed, and name it.
templates.whatItShows: A story played outdoors with a phone's GPS, with no coordinates to enter: it takes the player's position, scatters places to walk to around it, shows them on a map and notices when the player arrives. Every stop can be skipped.
